newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Pol Pot still alive, general says.
newsitem.headline: Pol Pot still alive, general says.

text.p: Khmer Rouge guerrilla strongman Pol Pot is still alive and will be handed over to the government very soon, a government general said on Sunday.
"Pol Pot is still alive. I met him this morning," General Nhiek Bun Chhay told reporters.
Earlier on Sunday, Cambodia's second prime minister Hun Sen said he had received an unconfirmed report that the ageing Pol Pot was dead.

Nhiek Bun Chhay, who has spearheaded talks with Khmer Rouge renegades who broke with Pol Pot earlier this month, said the guerrilla leader was being detained at the Anlong Veng jungle headquarters of the breakaway faction which captured him last week.
The general said Pol Pot was very sick and would be handed over to the government soon.
"They will give Pol Pot to the government very soon," he said upon his return from Anlong Veng.
